name.ja: ゴルフパートナー 都城練習場店

hours.en: Range weekdays 6:30–22:00, weekends and holidays 6:30–21:00. No early slot (6:30–8:30) on Mondays.

description.ja: 都城市若葉町の練習場。照明あり。ショップ・試打室・弾道測定・工房を併設。レッスン対応。
description.en: Range in Wakaba, Miyakonojo, with floodlights, a shop, fitting bay, launch monitor and club workshop. Lessons available.
description.ko: 미야코노조 와카바초의 연습장. 조명 있음. 숍·시타실·탄도 측정·공방 병설. 레슨 가능.
